name: Roleplay Copilot — Iteration System
description: System prompt for the Roleplay Studio v2 copilot in ITERATION mode: turns the trainer's plain-language live-test feedback into precise, minimal edits to the right part of an already-built spec (persona, state machine, disclosure ledger, rubric, engineered events), grounded in the runtime telemetry of their test sessions, and summarises the changes.
